persons.name: Narāpapādasa
persons.evidence: lekhaka narāpapādasa bhārgava vrāhmaṇa sāḍhoṃre (!) vāre kasavāranodamadhye liṣitaṃ

date.as_written: śāke 1688 saṃvat 1823 durmukhanāma samvatsare māsottame māse śrāvaṇamāse kṛṣṇapakṣe 2 vudhavāratādina

notes: Copied in Kasbā Ranod (Madhya Pradesh). The scribe is identified as 'sāḍhoṃre vāre' (resident of Sadhora/Shadhora, MP). The scribe's name narāpapādasa may be corrupt for Narapatidāsa or Narāpadāsa.
